name: BestHelpTool Product Descriptions for WooCommerce
author: besthelptool

sections.description:
Unlock explosive sales growth with the most powerful AI-driven product description generator for WooCommerce! Built to create 100% unique, plagiarism-free, evergreen, and addictive content that naturally engages your customers and boosts your SEO rankings effortlessly.

Stop wasting hours writing manual product descriptions or dealing with copied content from the internet. This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to cutting-edge AI (OpenAI, ChatGPT, LLM) to instantly generate friendly, neutral, and highly attractive descriptions that convert visitors into loyal buyers.

⭐ UPGRADE TO PRO FOR BULK GENERATION & ADVANCED AI CONTROLS ⭐

Free Version Features:
* ✅ Instantly generate high-quality, engaging product descriptions from the edit screen.
* ✅ 100% original, plagiarism-free AI content written by advanced Language Models.
* ✅ Unlimited single-product generations forever!

🚀 Unlock Ultimate Power with PRO:
* Bulk Generate: Rewrite your entire WooCommerce catalog in one click! The best WooCommerce AI bulk description writer.
* Custom Tones: Choose between Professional, Casual, Persuasive, or Technical.
* Multilingual: Instantly translate and generate descriptions in 10+ languages (Spanish, French, German, etc).
* Advanced SEO Mode: Automatically inject focus keywords into the perfect spots to rank on Google.
👉 Get the Pro Version Now!

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party AI services (by default OpenAI) to generate product descriptions.
– What data is sent: The product title, product tags, product categories, and attributes are sent to the AI API endpoint configured in the settings.
– Why it is sent: To generate contextual and accurate product descriptions using AI.
– Terms of Service: OpenAI Terms of Use
– Privacy Policy: OpenAI Privacy Policy

1.0.2

  • Added localization support for Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Portuguese.

1.0.3

  • Added Quick Guide tutorial to the settings page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/besthelptool-product-descriptions-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > AI Descriptions to set up your API Key.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API Key?

Yes, you need to provide your own OpenAI API key to use the service. You can set a custom endpoint if using a compatible API.

Does this work with ChatGPT 4?

Yes, the plugin supports all modern OpenAI models including GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and GPT-4o-mini for lighting fast WooCommerce description generation.

What features are in the Pro version?

Bulk generation, unlimited generations, SEO mode, Tone & Language selection. Check it out at https://besthelptool.site/wc-ai-description-pro/
